proposed_comments.title: Preserve the Advanced Paste hotkey ID contract

confidence.rationale: The new text-case leaves expand the Advanced Paste action tree; stale fixed action-count assumptions can relabel conflicts and shift custom-action IDs across settings and the runner.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the Advanced Paste hotkey ID contract

**Severity:** `high`

Adding the text-case action group changes the set of built-in Advanced Paste hotkeys. Please update the Settings UI conflict labels for every new text-case action, derive the custom-action boundary from the actual built-in action count instead of a fixed ID, and preserve the runner/settings contract for users upgrading from settings that do not yet contain `text-case`. Without that compatibility handling, shortcut conflicts can be shown under the wrong action name or custom action IDs can be interpreted differently between Settings and the module.

proposed_comments.title: Add root notice coverage for the Unicode data

confidence.rationale: The PR vendors Unicode sentence-break data for Advanced Paste; PowerToys keeps third-party attribution visible from the root notice as well as module-local files.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add root notice coverage for the Unicode data

**Severity:** `medium`

The new sentence-break data and generated lookup table are derived from Unicode data files. Please add the corresponding Unicode attribution to the root `NOTICE.md`, in addition to the module-local Unicode data license, so the distribution-level third-party notices include the new vendored material.
